data.long_meaning: One who meets the guru, receives the divine knowledge. In Sanskrit, 'gur' means teacher and 'meet' means meet. The name embodies the spirit of seeking knowledge from a wise guide. The name Gurmeet carries the meaning “Meet of the Guru” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gurmeet usually hope their child will grow to embody meet of the guru and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurmeet total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

The name is associated with the traditions of envy and respect for the guru-disciple relationship, a cornerstone of Indian society and religion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Gurmeet" holds immense spiritual significance as it symbolizes the journey of the soul toward enlightenment. The name implies that the individual bearing the name has sought the blessings and guidance of a spiritual teacher or guru and is endeavoring to absorb the divine knowledge imparted to them. The name signifies the active pursuit of spiritual truths and the desire to live a virtuous and pious life guided by the wisdom of a guru.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name "Gurmeet" in Hinduism is believed to mean "Meeting with the Guru." It symbolizes the profound encounter with the enlightened teacher, leading to spiritual growth and inner wisdom.
